description: This file defines the VisitService interface, which declares methods for managing visit-related operations in the OpenMRS healthcare software platform. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, retiring, voiding, and deleting visit types, visits, and visit attribute types, as well as methods for search and filtering of visits based on various criteria.

classes.name: VisitService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing hospital visits and visit types within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It extends OpenmrsService to include functionalities such as retrieving, saving, retiring, unretiring, and purging visit-related entities, as well as complex search and filtering operations.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all visit types in the system, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific visit type by its internal ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a specific visit type by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of visit types matching the fuzzy search phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Creates or updates a visit type in the database.

methods.name: retireVisitType
methods.description: Marks a visit type as retired, with a reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitType
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired visit type.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a visit type from the database.

methods.name: getAllVisits
methods.description: Returns all unvoided visits.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves a visit by ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Creates or updates a visit.

methods.name: endVisit
methods.description: Sets the stop date to close a visit.

methods.name: voidVisit
methods.description: Voids a visit with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidVisit
methods.description: Unvoids a previously voided visit.

methods.name: purgeVisit
methods.description: Permanently deletes a visit from database.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits matching complex criteria or search object.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all unvoided visits for a specific patient.

methods.name: getActiveVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all active (unvoided) visits for a patient.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all visits for a patient, with options to include inactive and voided.

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all visit attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute type by internal ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a visit attribute type.

methods.name: retireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a visit attribute type with a reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a visit attribute type.

methods.name: purgeVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a visit attribute type.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit attribute by UUID.

methods.name: stopVisits
methods.description: Stops all active visits started before or on the specified date, for certain visit types.
